issue_context.title: Administratos are refered to as owners in comment headings
issue_context.body: Comments for issues and PRs written by Collaborators in a project are tagged with "Owner" in the heading, if the collaborators have global admin access. I think this is not intended.
comments: This should be a bug but not an enhancement.
Isn't it just reflecting their role in the organization, if it is one?

> Isn't it just reflecting their role in the organization, if it is one?

I do not understand. Admin access is not on organization level, and I do not see why someone should be designated as "Owner" of a project, only because he can in principle do everything an owner could. It might not reflect the role of this user in the context of the given organization.

review_comments: Can the `Real` in the function name be avoided? It's not really a helpful name to someone reading this code as they don't know what is "real".
``IsUserRepoAdmin`` is exist which is used to check permission(the system administrator will have same permission with repo owner).
